questions.q: In Bach's Brandenburg Concerto No. 5, which keyboard instrument is a soloist?
questions.why: The harpsichord plays a solo role as well as continuo.

questions.q: What is the ground bass in Purcell's Music for a While?
options: A chord progression with no bass
questions.why: A ground bass is a bass pattern repeated while the upper parts change.

questions.q: Which form is the first movement of Beethoven's Pathétique sonata?
questions.why: It has exposition, development and recapitulation, plus the Grave introduction.

questions.q: Describe two production techniques used in Queen's Killer Queen.
questions.model: Multi-tracking of guitar and vocal harmonies, and panning/phasing/reverb effects to make a rich stereo sound.
